mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.email, m.password, m.name, m.agree_privacy, m.agree_openbank, m.joined_at, m.updated_at, m.is_deleted, a.authority FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_auth a ON m.member_id = a.member_id WHERE m.email = #{email} AND m.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( email, password, name, agree_privacy, agree_openbank ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{agreePrivacy}, #{agreeOpenbank} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT m.member_id, m.email, m.password, m.name, m.agree_privacy, m.agree_openbank, m.joined_at, m.updated_at, m.is_deleted, ma.authority FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_auth ma ON m.member_id = ma.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE member SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
